other_conditions: Applicant must have Pahani of the land where planting is being proposed
Registration must be completed before the end of May (before the rainy season)

Incentive payment is not available for certain tree species such as Eucalyptus, Acacia, Silver Oak (if planted in coffee estate), Casuarina, Cassia siamea, Gliricidia, Sesbania, Erythrina, Rubber, Subabul, Coconut, Arecanut, Orange, all types of citrus species and grafted mango
benefits_summary: Provides subsidized seedlings and monetary incentives to farmers for planting and nurturing trees, promoting increased forest cover.
documents_required: Pahani of the land where planting is being proposed
Details of seedlings (species, number of seedlings, size of poly-bags, etc.)
Details of the applicant's bank account
